tasks.name: linkedin-research
tasks.description: Research LinkedIn people and build a source-backed shortlist using LeadAdapter. Use for prospect research, people search and reviewed CRM handoff.

tasks.name: linkedin-post-engagers
tasks.description: Find and qualify people who engaged with a LinkedIn post using LeadAdapter. Use for post engagement research and lead shortlists.

tasks.name: linkedin-profile-enrichment
tasks.description: Enrich selected LinkedIn profiles through LeadAdapter. Use when an existing shortlist needs source-backed profile details.

tasks.name: linkedin-reviewed-crm
tasks.description: Promote an explicitly reviewed LinkedIn shortlist to LeadAdapter CRM and optionally sync an existing CRM connection. Use after research and review.
